cover: ALL 8 BILLION PEOPLE WOULD FIT IN A SUGAR CUBE
caption: Atoms really are almost all empty space. Squeeze it out and matter reaches nuclear density: about 230 million tonnes in one cubic centimetre. Every size and weight here is computed from that. The instant squeeze is dramatization, and its enormous energy is ignored.
